purpose: Reproducible host-side ONNX export and three-path parity policy for the two-class identity channel (central_tower vs similar_structure_ms1). Prepared before the selected two-class weights exist; the weight sha/class table/preprocessing/decoder are bound at run time and recorded in evidence.

scope.model: YOLOv8n-pose two-class (nc=2), selected weights from the two-class 3-seed phase (model_freeze_v3) - PENDING

export.expected_output_layout: (1, 9, 8400) = [cx, cy, w, h, score_class0, score_class1, kpt_x, kpt_y, kpt_conf]; class argmax over channels 4..5

keypoint_table.1: NOT_AVAILABLE (v=0 always; no bearing; bbox centre forbidden)

verification.raw_relative_note: absolute max diff is dominated by the coordinate channels whose values span 0..640; 0.001 relative = 0.64 input px
verification.class_argmax_mismatch_max: rate<=0.001 (see parity.tolerances); per-anchor count alone is not a fail
verification.class_argmax_note: per-anchor argmax over the two class scores between torch and onnxruntime must match on every compared canvas; any mismatch is a fail, not a warning

parity.table: parity.rows are appended under t37_two_class in docs/reports/perception/onnx_parity_20261104.json; the T14/T29 top-level sections are not modified
parity.preprocessing: one shared square center letterbox: auto=False, stride=32, pad=114, imgsz=640; every path consumes the same canvas PNG / float tensor

decoding.class1_keypoint: never emitted; raw keypoint columns for class1 are ignored; no bearing for class1

nms.conf_thres: configurable; default 0.01 so the frozen tau_det is applied once in decode
nms.note: class-aware offsets (class*max_wh) reproduce ultralytics multi-class NMS: overlapping boxes of different classes are both kept

parity.thresholds_expected_source: frozen two-class model/thresholds; values are read at run time from the freeze file, not invented here

tolerances.note: primary three-path parity requires zero flips on all two-class decision layers; legacy preprocessing mismatch is reported separately
tolerances.class_argmax_note: raw torch-vs-ORT per-anchor class argmax may flip for anchors whose two class scores differ below fp noise (~6.6e-6 observed); the pass criterion is mismatch rate <= 0.1% (observed 1.79e-4) AND zero decision/consumer flips

sample_policy.source_policy: val_main 163 + T19 identity 7 groups/190 frames + old exploratory pool read-only if needed; no holdout read

parity.thresholds_note: model_freeze_v3 does not exist for a rejected pilot; the run uses the T34 evaluator defaults tau_det=0.25/tau_margin=0.10/tau_kpt=0.5/tau_iou=0.3 (+tau_px=3.0 for the shared 2D diagnostic) and records them as PROPOSED_PILOT_DEFAULTS_NOT_FROZEN

environment_pins.note: the Isaac venv stays untouched; the isolated .venv/landmark-train is used for the run

license_and_usage.license_route: internal bounded research authorised by the user; distribution undecided; AGPL obligations unresolved; this is not a legal conclusion
license_and_usage.usage_boundary: host-side parity evidence only; no RK3576/board, no accuracy/identity certification, no navigation/Gate claim

candidate_note: R2 pilot last checkpoint (two_class_pilot_v7b/seed0); the pilot gate FAILED (same-frame disambiguation 0.50 < 0.60), so this is NOT a selected or validated model. T37 evidence is host-side ONNX/decoder parity only and must not be read as effect/identity/board evidence.
